text: When a pet dies or is made inactive, Scout closes everything still open for that pet, in one step.
Maria called: Juniper has passed away. Open Juniper's chart.
The one thing to remember: inactivate from the chart, and read the list before you accept.
Scout lists everything still open for Juniper.
Follow-ups waiting for a CL are removed. Her reminders stop, any open text offers expire, and waitlist entries are removed.
Memberships, auto-ships, refills and pharmacy orders too.
Maple and Pepper's visits and reminders aren't touched. Only Juniper's.

The most common mistakes: removing only the next visit and leaving reminders and follow-ups running, and accepting without reading the list. Remember: inactivate the pet from the chart and read the list before you accept.
